svg.title: Anatomy of one evaluation case
svg.desc: One evaluation case, late-evening-tz, shown as four stacked bands with a note beside each. Input, what the feature receives exactly as in production: the request "call the bank tomorrow", the members list with Ben Cho, the server time 2026-11-14T04:30:00Z, and the time zone America/Los_Angeles. Expectation, what a correct draft must satisfy, where keys that are left out are not checked: intent create_task and due date 2026-11-14, because it is still 20:30 on 13 November in Los Angeles. Slices, used for coverage and per-slice scores: date relative, time of day late-evening, assignee none, risk normal, language English. Lifecycle, used for gating, provenance, and versioning: split test, critical true, source incident INC-0412, labeled by pm-lead and eng-oncall, added in version 1.2.0, status active. The metadata, not the input, is what makes coverage, gating, and versioning possible.
